name: Deployment Diagram
description: Deployment Diagram describes how software artifacts are deployed onto physical nodes or execution environments, along with communication paths between them.
purpose: Design cloud, on-premise, or hybrid infrastructure architecture; plan service deployment.
bestFor: Design cloud, on-premise, or hybrid infrastructure architecture
Plan service deployment on containers, VMs, Kubernetes
Describe load balancer, database replication, CDN, message broker
Create DevOps or production architecture documentation
notSuitableFor: Describe logic module/service → use Component Diagram
Describe request processing flow → use Sequence Diagram
useCases: Identify physical nodes or execution environments
Draw communication path with protocol (HTTPS, gRPC, JDBC)
Add infrastructure service (LB, CDN, DB replica)

elements.name: Execution Environment
elements.description: Runtime containing artifacts: JVM, Pod, Node.js

elements.name: Communication Path
elements.description: Network connection + protocol: HTTPS, gRPC, JDBC

elements.name: Infrastructure Service
elements.description: LB, CDN, DB replica, cache, message broker

confusableWith.difference: Deployment answers 'where it runs'; Component answers 'what components the software consists of'.
Package describes source code organization; Deployment describes runtime/infrastructure deployment.
